generate.initial_sparql:
PREFIX wm: <https://wealth.example.org/ontology/>
PREFIX kg: <https://wealth.example.org/kg/>
PREFIX wmmeta: <https://wealth.example.org/metadata/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX schema1: <http://schema.org/>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

SELECT DISTINCT ?investorId ?investorName
WHERE {
  ?inv a wm:Investor ;
       wm:investorId ?investorId .
  OPTIONAL { ?inv wm:investorName ?investorName . }

  # Retirement Planning goal
  ?inv wm:hasInvestmentGoal ?goal .
  ?goal wm:investmentGoal ?goalName .
  FILTER(CONTAINS(LCASE(STR(?goalName)), "retirement planning"))

  # Bear Market scenario
  ?inv wm:hasScenarioRebalancing ?scenReb .
  ?scenReb wm:scenario ?scenarioName .
  FILTER(CONTAINS(LCASE(STR(?scenarioName)), "bear market"))

  # De‑risking action
  ?inv wm:hasRebalancingAction ?rebAct .
  ?rebAct wm:action ?actionName .
  FILTER(CONTAINS(LCASE(STR(?actionName)), "de-risking"))

  # Poor diversification (<25)
  ?inv wm:hasPortfolioHealth ?ph .
  ?ph wm:diversificationScore ?divScore .
  FILTER(xsd:decimal(?divScore) < 25)

  # Technology sector allocation
  ?inv wm:hasSectorAllocation ?secAlloc .
  ?secAlloc wm:hasSector ?sector .
  ?sector rdfs:label ?sectorLabel .
  FILTER(CONTAINS(LCASE(STR(?sectorLabel)), "technology"))
}
